purpose: Editable skill and requirement inventory with project evidence and recruiter-facing GitHub document links.
coverage_note: Broad extensible catalog across neuroengineering and adjacent engineering. It is not a list of universal hiring requirements or a claim that all skills are needed.
empty_value_policy: skill == "" means no experience statement has been entered. not_documented is unknown; none is an explicit absence of current experience.

status_definitions.not_documented: No current claim. Empty skill means experience has not been recorded, not that the person cannot have it.
status_definitions.none: Explicitly recorded as no current experience.
status_definitions.planned: A goal with no completed implementation recorded.
status_definitions.learning: Study or practice with no resume-ready implementation yet.
status_definitions.reported: Listed in a prior resume or discussion; implementation evidence needs to be attached.
status_definitions.exposure: Observed or assisted work; describe the limited scope.
status_definitions.in_progress: Active implementation with the remaining integration or verification stated.
status_definitions.prototype: An implemented research or bench prototype with limited scope.
status_definitions.implemented: A concrete implementation or task is documented; this does not imply independent performance validation.
status_definitions.validated: Implementation checked against stated independent or reproduced acceptance evidence.
status_definitions.production: Maintained operation in a stated deployment context with verification evidence.

resume_rules.note: A source review verifies code exists and its described scope; it is not a runtime, latency, clinical, or biological validation.

mathematics.label: Mathematics and numerical foundations

acquisition_signal_chain.label: Neural acquisition signal chain

electrodes_probes.label: Electrodes and neural interfaces

bench_instrumentation.label: Bench instrumentation and measurement

acquisition_platforms.label: Acquisition platforms and vendor interfaces
evidence_guidance: Link configuration or integration code and a reproducible setup guide.
State which hardware or replay path was actually exercised.

formats_metadata.label: Neural file formats and metadata
evidence_guidance: Link a parser or converter and a small approved test fixture.

preprocessing.label: Neural preprocessing and artifact handling
evidence_guidance: Link the processing configuration and implementation.
Show signal effects, edge cases, and causal or offline timing implications.

spike_sorting.label: Spike detection sorting and curation
evidence_guidance: Link the sorter configuration, recording context, and quality report.
Record ground truth or reference limitations and avoid inferring accuracy from a successful run.

neural_features.label: Single-unit and population features
evidence_guidance: Link event alignment, response windows, figures, and analysis code.
State the statistical procedure and whether validation data were held out.

experiment_timing.label: Experimental control and synchronization
evidence_guidance: Identify each clock, event marker, and physical onset reference.

realtime_streaming.label: Real-time and streaming systems
evidence_guidance: Link a paced-replay or live processing demonstration.

programming_languages.label: Programming languages
evidence_guidance: Link a substantive implementation in this language and describe your contribution.

scientific_software.label: Scientific computing libraries and tools
evidence_guidance: Link code that actually uses the library for a defined analysis.
Distinguish using a package from implementing its algorithms.

software_engineering.label: Software architecture and delivery
evidence_guidance: Link code, a design decision, or a reviewed change showing the practice.
State the maintained scope and user or research need.

validation_testing.label: Scientific and software validation
evidence_guidance: Link the fixture, expected result, check, and actual outcome.
Demonstrate a failure case and separate consistency checks from independent validation.

agentic_development.label: Agent-assisted engineering
evidence_guidance: Link the specification, resulting code, and acceptance evidence.
Record your decisions and how incorrect agent outputs were detected.

performance_gpu.label: Performance engineering and acceleration
evidence_guidance: Link a benchmark and baseline under the same workload and hardware.

embedded_firmware.label: Embedded systems and firmware
evidence_guidance: Link firmware, target board, build configuration, and debug or test evidence.
State hardware interfaces, memory, power, and timing constraints actually measured.

fpga_digital_design.label: FPGA and digital design
evidence_guidance: Link HDL, testbench, target device, build configuration, and synthesis/timing reports.

electronics_design.label: Analog digital and PCB electronics
evidence_guidance: Link schematics, simulations, board files, and bring-up or characterization results.

interfaces_networking.label: Interfaces networking and transport
evidence_guidance: Link protocol or interface code and communication tests.
Record packet framing, error handling, timing, and interoperability limits.

machine_learning.label: Machine learning methods
evidence_guidance: Link data lineage, train/evaluation partitions, model configuration, and results.

neural_decoding.label: Neural decoding and BCI
evidence_guidance: Link the neural input representation, decoder, and evaluation protocol.

semantic_memory.label: Semantic tuning and memory experiments
evidence_guidance: Link stimulus definitions, semantic representation, response criteria, and analysis.
Separate imposed simulation tuning from demonstrated human concept specificity.

computational_modeling.label: Computational neuroscience and simulation
evidence_guidance: Link model equations, parameters, seeds, code, and diagnostic outputs.
State model assumptions and distinguish simulated effects from biological validation.

statistics_design.label: Statistics and experimental design
evidence_guidance: Link the design, assumptions, analysis code, and interpretable results.
State confounding, dependence, multiplicity, and held-out evaluation limits.

data_engineering.label: Data engineering and scientific storage
evidence_guidance: Link data schemas, transformations, lineage, and recovery or quality checks.
State dataset scale and operational scope actually supported.

cloud_devops.label: Cloud operations and deployment
evidence_guidance: Link deployment configuration and a reproducible operation or recovery procedure.

clinical_research.label: Human clinical research workflows

quality_regulatory.label: Quality systems and regulated development

stimulation_closed_loop.label: Stimulation and closed-loop research

biomedical_modalities.label: Other biomedical and neural modalities

visualization_interfaces.label: Visualization and research interfaces
evidence_guidance: Link source and a demonstration or output figure.

control_robotics.label: Control systems and assistive devices
evidence_guidance: Link the controller, plant or device model, and test conditions.

mechanical_manufacturing.label: Mechanical implant and manufacturing engineering

research_laboratory.label: Laboratory and preclinical research

communication_project_work.label: Scientific communication and project work

transferable_it_data.label: Transferable IT operations and analytics

deep_array_bench.limitations: Bench outcome is not human unit yield or independent clinical acquisition.

sorting_workflows.limitations: No cross-sorter accuracy or live unit-identity guarantee is established.

format_comparisons.summary: CSC and MED-derived processing comparisons and precision discrepancy investigation.
